# Mukesh Saree Centre

Mukesh Saree Centre is a premier saree and ethnic wear retailer and wholesaler based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, established in 1978. We offer authentic Paithani sarees, Banarasi silk sarees, bridal sarees, wedding sarees, Malvika saree collections, soft cotton drapes, and institutional uniform saree solutions online and at our Gandhibagh, Nagpur showroom with Cash on Delivery across India.

## Malvika Saree Collection
The Malvika Saree collection features luxurious, easy-to-drape sarees perfect for modern ethnic wear. These sarees combine traditional weaving techniques with contemporary designs, offering a lightweight yet rich aesthetic ideal for both casual and festive occasions.

## Uniform Saree Bulk Orders
We specialize in bulk uniform saree orders for institutions, schools, hospitals, and corporate offices. We provide high-quality, durable, and comfortable uniform sarees with consistent colors and weaves, ensuring professional elegance for your entire team.

## Saree Shop in Nagpur
Our flagship retail showroom is located at Jagnath Road, Gandhibagh, Nagpur. For over 46 years, we have been Vidarbha's most trusted destination for authentic handloom masterpieces, bridal lehengas, party wear sarees, and traditional silk sarees.
